name: AD828
type: Bipolar VFB dual video op-amp, optimised for G ≥ +2
tagline: ADI's 130 MHz, 450 V/µs dual video op-amp; Chinese sound-card and car-audio modders rate it above the AD827.

lineage.note: Sole source; no second sources known. Relation to AD826/AD827/AD847 dies is unconfirmed.

part_numbers.note: Family part number; ADI product page is live.
8-lead PDIP. Listed in ADI PDN 10_0081 Rev. B; last-time-buy date unknown.
8-lead SOIC, leaded (non-RoHS). Probably superseded by AD828ARZ.
8-lead SOIC, RoHS. -REEL/-REEL7 suffixes likely but unconfirmed.

key_specs.value: 130 MHz −3 dB bandwidth; 0.1 dB flat to 40 MHz

reputation.summary: Praise comes from Chinese DIY sources. A CSDN ranking of 22 op-amps credits the AD828AN with 'jump, grandeur, extension' but a slightly rough midrange, above the AD827. Elecfans calls the AD828AR neutral, with strong bass dynamics and clear, extended highs. Autohome car-audio modders use it; one Bilibili review was negative. No Western or measurement-based consensus.
typical_uses: Vendor intent: video line and cable drivers, G ≥ +2
caveats: Optimised for G ≥ +2; may ring or oscillate as a unity-gain buffer. Check stability and decoupling.
Praise is subjective, mostly from Chinese forums and marketing-style pages; one Bilibili review was negative.
PDIP AD828AN appears discontinued; marketplace DIP parts may be new-old stock or remarked.

counterfeit_notes: No AD828-specific counterfeit reports. The PDIP AD828AN is in ADI PDN 10_0081 Rev. B, so DIP-8 parts and cheap AD828 boards may be new-old stock, pulls or remarks. Buy SOIC AD828ARZ from authorised distributors.
